task: Version the basic T-shirt care anchor to reflect the user decision that specific applicable care is sufficient, while preserving the original rule and pilot judgments.
nonGoals: Change original v1 category policy, frozen fixtures or historical pilot expectations
Alter category weights or other scoring rules
Retroactively revise human or model results
Implement production scoring or deploy services

outcomes.description: A distinct versioned basic T-shirt care policy grants full credit for specific applicable care, including washing alone, and preserves partial for materially incomplete scope and zero for absence or unusable information.
The old policy and blind human pilot remain intact, and documentation identifies the user's clarified choice without claiming retroactive agreement.
outcomes.evidence: Versioned policy diff, pilot record and independent review

process.description: Validate and commit this plan alone before the requirement change; independently review old-gold preservation and scope.

styleEfficiency.description: Limit the version change to the care anchor and document version selection and unchanged weights.

exitTest.reason: This rule-only version clarification does not change portability, memory, workflow, handoff or resumability; the separate phase-2-closure plan still requires its fresh-agent exit test.
